title: Shannon Global Energy Solutions
content:
Shannon Global Energy Solutions supplies engineered thermal-management systems for industrial and energy-sector customers. The company integrates and distributes third-party aerogel materials in removable insulation blankets and related high-performance insulation packages.

  • Coverage Area: United States and North American project markets
  • Focus Areas: Removable insulation blankets, industrial thermal management, energy-efficiency upgrades, and aerogel-based engineered insulation systems
  • Current Brands Represented: Third-party aerogel blanket inputs used in engineered insulation systems, including project-specified Aspen Aerogels and similar materials
  • Official Website: https://www.shannonglobalenergy.com/
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
